REQ-F-01.statement: The system shall store a name, an address and a phone number for each customer, together with an optional bank account of which a customer may have at most one.

REQ-F-02.statement: The system shall store a name, a description, a price and an image for each product.

REQ-F-03.statement: The system shall record, for each order, invoice and payment, enough information to tell when it was made, how much money it concerns, what state it is currently in, and by which means payment is to be made.

REQ-F-04.statement: The system shall record each order item with a quantity and the unit price at which the product is sold.

REQ-F-05.statement: The system shall relate the business entities as follows: a customer places orders, and every order is placed by one customer; an order is made up of order items, and every order item names one product; a product may be sold through many order items or through none at all; an order may be billed by at most one invoice; and an invoice is settled by payments, each of which is submitted against that invoice.

REQ-F-06.statement: The system shall treat an order item as a part of its order that has no business meaning on its own and never belongs to a different order.

REQ-F-07.statement: The system shall allow a customer to submit an order that names a known customer, contains one or more order items each naming an existing product, and carries a payment method, and shall register it as an order with the submission date as its order date and the status submitted.

REQ-F-08.statement: The system shall register no order when a submission fails to meet any of the conditions for a valid submission.

REQ-F-09.statement: The system shall record for each registered order a total amount equal to the sum over its order items of quantity multiplied by unit price.

REQ-F-10.statement: The system shall allow order staff to receive an order whose status is submitted by setting its status to pending.

REQ-F-11.statement: The system shall allow order staff to mark an order whose status is pending as filled.

REQ-F-12.statement: The system shall allow order staff to decline an order whose status is pending by setting its status to closed, after which the order is not fulfilled further.

REQ-F-13.statement: The system shall allow order staff to set the status of an order to shipped when its status is filled.

REQ-F-14.statement: The system shall allow an accountant to raise an invoice, with the status issued, for an order that has been filled and does not yet have one.

REQ-F-15.statement: The system shall treat the delivery of a filled order and the billing of that order as two concerns that are carried out separately and neither of which waits for the other to finish.

REQ-F-16.statement: The system shall allow a customer to submit a payment against an invoice that is still awaiting settlement, with a date, an amount and a payment method, and shall record the payment as awaiting confirmation.

REQ-F-17.statement: The system shall allow a customer to submit a further, separate payment against an invoice whose earlier payment has failed, and shall leave the earlier payment as it stands.

REQ-F-18.statement: The system shall allow an accountant to confirm a payment that is awaiting confirmation, which both completes that payment and settles the invoice it was submitted against.

REQ-F-19.statement: The system shall allow an accountant to reject a payment that is awaiting confirmation, which fails that payment and leaves the invoice unsettled.

REQ-F-20.statement: The system shall allow order staff to close an order once it has been delivered to the customer and its invoice has been settled.

REQ-F-21.statement: The system shall regard an order as finished only when both of the concerns of REQ-F-15 have concluded, whichever of the two concludes last.

REQ-F-22.statement: The system shall not change the status of an order whose status is closed.

REQ-F-23.statement: The system shall reject any request to change the status of an order, an invoice or a payment that the permitted status changes do not allow, or whose stated preconditions are not met, and shall leave the status unchanged.

REQ-F-24.statement: The system shall leave the status of an order, an invoice or a payment unchanged when the status of one of the other two changes, except where a requirement states otherwise.

REQ-F-25.statement: The system shall treat every attribute as mandatory, except the bank account of a customer, and shall reject a record in which a mandatory attribute is absent.

REQ-F-26.statement: The system shall represent monetary values (product price, unit price, order total, invoice amount, payment amount) as decimal numbers.

REQ-F-27.statement: The system shall restrict the status of an order to submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed; of an invoice to issued or paid; and of a payment to pending, completed or failed.

REQ-F-28.statement: The system shall restrict the payment method recorded on an order, on an invoice and on a payment to bank, card or cash.

REQ-F-29.statement: The system shall change the status of an order only from submitted to pending, from pending to filled or to closed, from filled to shipped, and from shipped to closed.

REQ-F-30.statement: The system shall change the status of an invoice only from issued to paid, and the status of a payment only from pending to completed or to failed.

REQ-N-01.statement: When a user submits an order containing up to 50 order items under normal operating conditions, the system shall register the order and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of submissions.

REQ-N-02.statement: Under normal operating conditions, the system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second while meeting the response time of REQ-N-01.

REQ-N-03.statement: The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.

REQ-N-04.statement: When a server failure occurs, the system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes without losing any order, invoice or payment recorded before the failure.

REQ-N-05.statement: The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.

REQ-N-06.statement: The system shall allow only users holding the accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.

REQ-N-07.statement: The system shall protect customer personal data and bank account numbers by encrypting them in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest.

REQ-N-08.statement: The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice and a payment, and shall retain these records for at least 12 months.
